title: SRFTI students protest in Kolkata over campus security and vice-chancellor

tea.why: Students are protesting over campus security and following clashes with groups linked to the RSS.
tea.want: Students are demanding the vice-chancellor's resignation, revocation of disciplinary notices, and an independent inquiry into campus violence.
tea.changed: Oct 15: SRFTI rusticated six students following an office vandalism incident and an alleged assault on the vice-chancellor.

summary: Students at the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute (SRFTI) in Kolkata launched an academic shutdown and indefinite sit-in following campus clashes with outfits linked to the RSS. The protests escalated as students demanded the resignation of Vice-Chancellor Santosh Ajmera, the revocation of disciplinary notices, and an independent inquiry into campus violence. According to institute statements, the vice-chancellor's office was vandalized, windows were shattered, and Ajmera was later allegedly manhandled and verbally abused by students following a meeting. In response, an emergency Dean Council meeting recommended immediate safety measures, the installation of CCTV cameras, and the rustication of six students involved in the violence and vandalism, while authorities prepared to register a police FIR against a student leader.
response: According to institute statements and officials, SRFTI rusticated six students, planned an FIR against a student leader, and the vice-chancellor condemned the vandalism and assault as unacceptable while calling for strict action.

updates.text: SRFTI students union began an academic shutdown over campus security issues.
The students' union wrote to the SRFTI Chairman demanding the VC's resignation and an independent inquiry.
SRFTI authorities rusticated six students following campus vandalism and an alleged assault on the Vice-Chancellor.
